assessment_objectives.objective: the Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) for which a Bill of Materials (BOM) is required are defined.

a Bill of Materials (BOM) is generated for internally developed Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), or obtained from the supplier for acquired TAAS, that identifies the components comprising the TAAS.
each Bill of Materials (BOM) records the version of each component.
each Bill of Materials (BOM) records supplier information for each component.
Bills of Material (BOMs) are updated when the components comprising the Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) change.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: upon each release or change to the component composition of the TAAS, and reviewed at least annually
